content: Docker patterns for PG17 + extensions + seed data: use official postgres:17 image, install extension packages (orafce, pgtap) in a custom Dockerfile layer via apt (postgresql-17-orafce, postgresql-17-pgtap), then CREATE EXTENSION in an init script under /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/ (numbered .sql files run in order, only on first init of an empty data dir). Seed/master data loads as later-numbered init scripts or as a separate psql -f step after container start. Mount data volume at /var/lib/postgresql/data, not /var/lib/postgresql, for PG17. Prebuilt multi-extension images exist (pglayers) but a custom Dockerfile is more auditable and pins exact orafce/pgtap versions for reproducible CI.
